ordered_features.name: historical_magnitude
ordered_features.calculation: Magnitude_Value of historical event j; never target event t

ordered_features.name: event_rate_30d
ordered_features.calculation: Count of retained events in (time(j)-30 days,time(j)] divided by 30; initial history is left-censored

ordered_features.name: mean_magnitude_20
ordered_features.calculation: Mean magnitude over retained events max(0,j-19)..j

ordered_features.name: std_magnitude_20
ordered_features.calculation: Population magnitude standard deviation (ddof=0) over max(0,j-19)..j; singleton=0

ordered_features.name: mean_depth_20_km
ordered_features.calculation: Mean depth over retained events max(0,j-19)..j

ordered_features.name: std_depth_20_km
ordered_features.calculation: Population depth standard deviation (ddof=0) over max(0,j-19)..j; singleton=0

excluded: source/trace IDs, absolute timestamps, target-event attributes, synthetic arrivals/SNR, waveform and simulator fields
feature_dependency_provenance: catalog_feature_events.csv intervals refer to catalog_events.csv event_index
raw_missing_policy: Only undefined first inter-event gap expected; train-fitted median imputation
historical_scope: Retained ML catalog only; rolling features may use older history than explicit 20-row window
